verify.general: yes: home-page SAMPLE BALLOT section refers to early voting from Oct 19 and Election Day "November 3rd"; image (wp-content/uploads/2026/10/1.png) shows general-election ballot numbers and only nominees.
verify.note: Image confirmed in Chrome on dpop.us and read at full resolution: every name and office matches. Unlabeled circuit 103-107 map to the single candidates of the Burke/Cobbs/Coghlan/Hooks/Karkula countywide vacancies; 11th Subcircuit Knox = McLean Meyerson vacancy and Przekota = Roberts vacancy (each the only candidate). "Vote YES to Retain All Judges" names no judges, so no retention entries (correct).
